description: US stocks and ETFs (of the 420 Portfolio Terminal covers) going ex-dividend in a month or a date range: ex-dividend date, pay date, dividend per share, yield, frequency, and whether the date is confirmed by the company or estimated from its payment rhythm. Buy before the ex-date to receive the dividend. Filter by one ticker with `symbol`.

days.description: Length of the range that starts at `from`, in calendar days (1–31, default 10).

from.description: First day of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of `month`). Use it for "this week" or "the next 10 days".

limit.description: How many entries, earliest first to return (1–200, default 50).

month.description: A calendar month as YYYY-MM, from three months back to three months ahead. Defaults to the current month. Ignored when `from` is given.

name: dividend_calendar
title: Dividend calendar
